planets.name: K2-3 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-3 with a 44.6-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-3 d was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-3. Its orbit and size follow Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DIAMOND_LOWE_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2015, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 3; pl_orbper 44.556456, pl_radj 0.13007427, pl_bmassj 0.00692197

quotes.title: K2-3d
quotes.card: K2-3d, also known as EPIC 201367065 d, is a confirmed exoplanet of probable mini-Neptune type orbiting the red dwarf star K2-3, and the outermost of three such planets discovered in the system.
quotes.introduction: It is located 143 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Leo.
